I told Dana in her #north-team thread that the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is 261 seats. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on 14 Oct, and nobody there has given a different number since.

I also said that the 185 seats from August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the renewal figure.

Dana is in #north-team, so she could already see Ilse's post. I didn't read anything outside that channel to answer her.
